title: The SARS-CoV-2 M(pro) Dimer-Based Screening System: A Synthetic Biology Tool for Identifying Compounds with Dimerization Inhibitory Potential.
authors: Giri-Rachman, Ernawati Arifin; Effendy, Vergio V; Azmi, Muhammad H S; Yamahoki, Nicholas; Stephanie, Rebecca; Agustiyanti, Dian F; Wisnuwardhani, Popi H; Angelina, Marissa; Rubiyana, Yana; Aditama, Reza; Ningrum, Ratih A; Wardiana, Andri; Fibriani, Azzania
one_liner_zh: 该文构建SARS-CoV-2主蛋白酶二聚化抑制剂筛选系统，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合域（AraC）和分子对接，但核心是药物筛选而非TF-DNA互作机制研究，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: The COVID-19 endemic remains a global concern. The search for effective antiviral candidates is still needed to reduce disease risk. However, the availability of high biosafety level laboratory facilities for drug screening is limited in number. To address this issue, a screening system that could be utilized at lower biosafety levels remains essential. This study aimed to develop a novel SARS-CoV-2 main protease (M(pro)) dimer-based screening system (DBSS) utilizing synthetic biology in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3). We linked the SARS-CoV-2 M(pro) with the DNA-binding domain of AraC regulatory protein, which regulates the reporter gene expression. Protein modeling and molecular docking showed that saquinavir could bind to AraC-M(pro) both in its monomer and dimer forms. The constructed DBSS assay indicated the screening system could detect saquinavir inhibitory activity at a concentration range of 4-10 mug/mL compared to the untreated control (P </= 0.05). The Vero E6 cell assay validated the DBSS result that saquinavir at 4-10 mug/mL exhibited antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2. Our DBSS could be used for preliminary screening of numerous drug candidates that possess a dimerization inhibitor activity of SARS-CoV-2 M(pro) and also minimize the use of a high biosafety level laboratory.
abstract_zh: COVID-19地方性流行仍是全球关注的问题。仍需寻找有效的抗病毒候选药物以降低疾病风险。然而，可用于药物筛选的高生物安全级别实验室设施数量有限。为解决这一问题，开发一种可在较低生物安全级别下使用的筛选系统仍然至关重要。本研究旨在利用合成生物学在大肠杆菌BL21(DE3)中开发一种新型SARS-CoV-2主蛋白酶（M(pro)）二聚体筛选系统（DBSS）。我们将SARS-CoV-2 M(pro)与AraC调控蛋白的DNA结合域连接，该蛋白调控报告基因表达。蛋白质建模和分子对接显示，沙奎那韦（saquinavir）能够以单体和二聚体形式与AraC-M(pro)结合。构建的DBSS检测表明，与未处理对照相比，该筛选系统可检测到4-10 μg/mL浓度范围内沙奎那韦的抑制活性（P ≤ 0.05）。Vero E6细胞实验验证了DBSS结果，即4-10 μg/mL的沙奎那韦对SARS-CoV-2表现出抗病毒活性。我们的DBSS可用于初步筛选具有SARS-CoV-2 M(pro)二聚化抑制活性的多种候选药物，并减少对高生物安全级别实验室的使用。
